Specification: This module is the standard TLC support module used by the TLC model checker. It defines TLC-specific helper operators for printing, assertions, timing, stateful instrumentation via TLCGet and TLCSet, finite-function operators such as :> and @@, permutations, sequence sorting, random element selection, string conversion, and forced evaluation with TLCEval. The file contains explanatory comments about TLC's evaluation strategy, randomization behavior, and worker-thread behavior, but it does not define a state-machine specification with variables, next-state actions, fairness, or temporal properties.
IfThenElse: IF val = TRUE THEN TRUE ELSE CHOOSE v : TRUE
IF x \in DOMAIN f THEN f[x] ELSE g[x]
FunctionConstructor: [x \in (DOMAIN f) \cup (DOMAIN g) |-> IF x \in DOMAIN f THEN f[x] ELSE g[x]]
ChoiceExpr:
CHOOSE p \in Permutations(1 .. Len(s)) :
                  \A i, j \in 1..Len(s) : 
                     (i < j) => Op(s[p[i]], s[p[j]]) \/ (s[p[i]] = s[p[j]])
CHOOSE x \in [a : v, b : STRING] : TRUE

FunctionConstructor_ByDomain: [x \in (DOMAIN f) \cup (DOMAIN g) |-> IF x \in DOMAIN f THEN f[x] ELSE g[x]]
DivisionNotes: PrintT is classified as a StatePredicate because it is Boolean-valued (TRUE), contains no primed variables, and contains no temporal operators.

Assert, JavaTime, TLCGet, TLCSet, Permutations, SortSeq, RandomElement, Any, ToString, and TLCEval are placed in ValueDef because they define computed values or helper operators rather than temporal properties, init predicates, or actions.
Print, :>, and @@ are also placed in ValueDef by elimination as non-temporal helper/value definitions.
Partition count: StatePredicate(1) + TemporalProperty(0) + Init(0) + ValueDef(13) + ActionDefNames(0) = OperatorDefNames(14). Verified.

FunctionConstructor contains a record constructor entry "[a : v, b : STRING]" that is syntactically also listed in FunctionConstructor by V2, but it is not a [x \in S |-> e] form. It is therefore included in FunctionConstructor_SetType by elimination so that FunctionConstructor_ByDomain and FunctionConstructor_SetType exactly partition the inherited V2 FunctionConstructor list.
TemporalNesting is false. No temporal operator appears explicitly nested inside another temporal operator in this file.
